annotations.title: Cancel a batch of scheduled posts

description: Cancel 1 to 20 queued deliveries atomically in one call. Call it only after the user said yes. If any delivery is already being sent or has finished, nothing is cancelled.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

ids.description: One to 20 unique queued delivery ids from jobs_list, schedule or schedule_batch to cancel together.

name: jobs_cancel_batch
